name: Infoblox — DNS Query Flood From Single Client
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = infoblox_infoblox_raw
| filter xdm.event.type = "DNS Query"
| filter xdm.source.ipv4 != null
| alter domain = arrayindex(regextract(xdm.event.description, "query: (\S+) IN"), 0)
| bin _time span = 5m
| comp count() as queries,
       count_distinct(xdm.event.description) as distinct_queries,
       values(domain) as queried_domains
       by xdm.source.ipv4, _time
| filter queries >= 200 and distinct_queries >= 50
| fields xdm.source.ipv4, queried_domains
description: Anomalous DNS query volume from one client — DoS or flood signal.
alert_name: Infoblox — DNS Query Flood From Single Client
alert_description:
What fired: Anomalous DNS query volume from one client — DoS or flood signal.

Why it matters: activity may degrade, deny, or destroy systems or data. Assessed severity: Medium.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1498 - Network Denial of Service (TA0040 - Impact).

Investigate:
  - Identify the affected systems and the source/principal driving the volume.
  - Assess blast radius and whether service degradation, encryption, or deletion is actively occurring.
  - Pivot on the alert's key entity (xdm.source.ipv4) to related activity in the same window.
  - Confirm the activity is not expected/authorized for the involved entity before escalating.
